user.title: Connect to ZONT Local
user.description: Enter the controller's local IP address and credentials.

heating_mode.title: ZONT Local settings
heating_mode.description: Select the ZONT mode that turns off all DHW and consumer circuits, the DHW turn-on temperature used after restarting Home Assistant, and the full refresh interval.

data_description.scan_interval: Live changes arrive immediately over WebSocket. A shorter interval increases the controller load.

devices.title: Import devices
devices.description: Select the ZONT devices to add to Home Assistant. The controller and its general diagnostic entities are always added.

data_description.auto_import_new_objects: Explicitly excluded devices will not be added again. This option applies only to previously unknown objects.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the ZONT Local connection
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address or username. Leave the password field empty to keep the current password.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate ZONT Local
reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller
error.cannot_read_devices: Unable to retrieve the ZONT device list
error.cannot_identify: The controller did not return its serial number or model information
error.cannot_read_modes: Unable to read the heating mode configuration
error.different_controller: A different ZONT controller was found at this address
error.invalid_dhw_on_temperature: Enter a DHW turn-on temperature from 5 to 75 °C
error.invalid_device_selection: Select devices only from the provided list
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address
error.invalid_off_mode: The selected mode can no longer turn off all circuits
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a full refresh interval from 10 to 120 seconds
error.no_off_mode: No mode with a zero setpoint for all DHW and consumer circuits was found

abort.no_off_mode: No ZONT mode that turns off all DHW and consumer circuits was found. Create or correct such a mode in ZONT and add the integration again.

general.title: ZONT Local settings
general.description: Select the ZONT mode with a zero setpoint for all DHW and consumer circuits, the DHW turn-on temperature, and the full refresh interval.

data_description.scan_interval: Live changes arrive immediately over WebSocket. A shorter interval increases the controller load.

devices.title: Import devices
devices.description: Select the ZONT devices to add to Home Assistant. An empty list leaves only the controller and its general entities.

data_description.auto_import_new_objects: Explicitly excluded devices remain excluded. New supported objects will be added without restarting Home Assistant.

export_create_source.title: New ZONT sensor
export_create_source.description: Select a Home Assistant temperature sensor or binary sensor whose value should be sent to ZONT.

export_create.title: Create a ZONT sensor
export_create.description: A compatible ZONT object of type “{kind}” will be created for {source}. The object will remain in the controller if the link is later removed.

export_link.title: Link an existing sensor
export_link.description: Select a Home Assistant temperature sensor or binary sensor.

export_link_target.title: Select a ZONT sensor
export_link_target.description: Select a compatible ZONT object for an export of type “{kind}”.

export_link_confirm.title: Confirm link
export_link_confirm.description: The value of {source} will be written to {target} (ID {target_id}) and updated regularly. Make sure that the selected ZONT object is intended for external data.

export_manage.title: Manage exports
export_manage.description: Select the link to change or remove.

export_change_source.title: Change source
export_change_source.description: Select a new source of type “{kind}” for {target} (ID {target_id}). Its current value will be sent before saving.

export_rebind.title: Change ZONT sensor
export_rebind.description: Select a new ZONT object for this link.

export_rebind_confirm.title: Confirm new target
export_rebind_confirm.description: The value of {source} will be written to {target} (ID {target_id}). The previous object will remain in ZONT and will not be imported into Home Assistant automatically.

export_delete.title: Remove link
export_delete.description: Data transfer to {target} (ID {target_id}) will stop. The object will remain in ZONT and in the list of devices excluded from import.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the controller
error.cannot_read_devices: Unable to retrieve the ZONT device list
error.cannot_read_modes: Unable to read the heating mode configuration
error.invalid_dhw_on_temperature: Enter a DHW turn-on temperature from 5 to 75 °C
error.invalid_device_selection: Select devices only from the provided list
error.invalid_off_mode: The selected mode can no longer turn off all circuits
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a full refresh interval from 10 to 120 seconds
error.invalid_export_source: Select a supported Home Assistant temperature sensor or binary sensor with an available state
error.invalid_export_target: The selected ZONT object is unavailable or does not match the source type
error.duplicate_export_source: This Home Assistant sensor is already used by another link
error.duplicate_export_target: This ZONT object is already used by another link
error.export_command_rejected: The controller rejected writing to the selected object
error.export_name_in_use: An object with this name already exists. Link the existing sensor instead
error.no_off_mode: No mode with a zero setpoint for all DHW and consumer circuits was found

export_source_missing.title: ZONT export source not found
export_source_missing.description: The Home Assistant source for {target} (ID {target_id}) was removed. Change or remove the link in the ZONT integration options.

export_source_invalid.title: ZONT export source is no longer compatible
export_source_invalid.description: The Home Assistant source for {target} (ID {target_id}) no longer matches the link type. Change or remove the link.

export_target_invalid.title: ZONT export target not found
export_target_invalid.description: The object {target} (ID {target_id}) is missing or no longer matches the link type. Select another target or remove the link.

export_command_rejected.title: ZONT rejected the export
export_command_rejected.description: The controller rejected writing to {target} (ID {target_id}). Check the object and relink it in the integration options if necessary.

heating_off_mode_invalid.title: The heating turn-off mode is no longer suitable
heating_off_mode_invalid.description: The selected ZONT mode is missing or no longer turns off all DHW and consumer circuits. Circuit on/off controls are temporarily unavailable. Select a suitable mode in the ZONT Local integration options.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends one generic command over the persistent ZONT WebSocket connection.

send_bulk.name: Send multiple commands
send_bulk.description: Sends multiple generic ZONT commands in sequence.

commands.name: Commands
commands.description: A non-empty list of objects with id and cmd fields.

entry_not_loaded.message: The ZONT configuration entry is not loaded

controller_offline.message: The ZONT controller is not connected

temperature_control_unavailable.message: Temperature control is unavailable for this circuit because the controller did not return a supported configuration

heating_hvac_mode_unavailable.message: This circuit operating mode is not supported

heating_preset_mode_unavailable.message: Preset “{preset_mode}” is unavailable for this circuit

heating_operation_mode_unavailable.message: DHW operation mode “{operation_mode}” is unavailable for this circuit

heating_off_mode_unavailable.message: The configured turn-off mode is unavailable for this circuit

heating_turn_on_unavailable.message: Unable to determine a safe state for turning on the circuit

relay_control_unavailable.message: Relay control is unavailable because the controller did not return the inverted-mode configuration

relay_state_not_confirmed.message: The controller accepted the command for relay {id} but did not confirm the new state

security_zone_state_not_confirmed.message: The controller accepted the command for security zone {id} but did not confirm the new state
